# Test pe cache commands - verifiable shared caching

# Basic cache operations
exec pe cache status
stdout 'Cache Status:'
stdout 'Entries: 0'

# Run with caching
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe run 'What is 2+2?' --cache --provider mock
stdout '4'

# Check cache was populated
exec pe cache status
stdout 'Cache Status:'
stdout 'Entries:'

# List cache entries
exec pe cache list
stdout 'Cache entries:'

# Clear cache
exec pe cache clear
stdout 'Cache cleared'

# Verify cache is empty
exec pe cache status
stdout 'Entries: 0'

# Show cache statistics
exec pe cache stats
stdout 'Cache statistics:'
stdout 'Total entries: 0'

# Export cache (when populated)
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe run 'Test prompt' --cache --provider mock
stdout 'Mock response'
exec pe cache export -o cache-export.tar.gz
stdout 'Exported'
exists cache-export.tar.gz

# Import cache
exec pe cache clear
stdout 'Cache cleared'
exec pe cache import cache-export.tar.gz
stdout 'Imported'

# Verify cache
exec pe cache verify
stdout 'Cache verification'
stdout 'Valid entries:'
